name: PDFForge Studio v1.3.3 (Native Rust Edition)
notes: PDFForge Studio v1.3.3: Fixed large-PDF crash (0xc0000409) caused by non-total-order layout baseline sorting on dense/scanned/OCR documents, added worker-thread panic isolation and diagnostic logging, native PDFium file streaming for layout/OCR inspection, bounded background cache encoding, OCR bridge fix, and RangeTransport retry resilience.
